name: The Signal
notes: Downtown concert hall hosting national and regional touring music acts on a rolling calendar.

name: Chattanooga Brewing Co.
notes: Brewery with recurring weekly trivia, open mic nights, and live music events.

name: Creative Discovery Museum
notes: Children's museum running regular family programs, camps, and after-hours special events.

name: Tivoli Theatre
notes: Historic downtown theater (Tivoli Foundation) hosting a rolling calendar of Broadway shows, concerts, and comedy.

name: WanderLinger Brewing Company
notes: Southside brewery with recurring live music, trivia, and special community events.

name: Hunter Museum of American Art
notes: Riverfront art museum with recurring programs like monthly Sunday Studios family days plus rotating exhibitions and events.

name: Barking Legs Theater
notes: Intimate 76-seat performing arts theater with weekly Wednesday Night Jazz, an open mic cabaret, and a rolling schedule of concerts, dance, and plays.

name: The Comedy Catch
notes: Longstanding downtown stand-up comedy club running weekly shows with touring and regional comics Wednesday through Sunday.

name: TailGate Brewery Chattanooga
notes: Taproom with recurring weekly trivia on Thursdays and movie nights on Fridays plus other community events.

name: Five Wits Brewing Company
notes: Southside brewery with weekly Thursday trivia, Sunday patio music from local musicians, and a summer bluegrass jam series.

name: Soldiers & Sailors Memorial Auditorium
notes: Historic 1924 downtown auditorium (Tivoli Foundation) hosting a rolling calendar of touring concerts, comedy headliners, and family shows.

name: Flat Top Mountain Farm
notes: Soddy-Daisy family farm with seasonal agritourism events including U-pick lavender, sunflower and corn mazes, hayrides, and a fall festival.

name: Reflection Riding
notes: Nonprofit nature center and native plant sanctuary with recurring programming including Campfire Concerts, guided wildflower and nature hikes, and seasonal family events.

name: Chattanooga Theatre Centre
notes: Community theater at 400 River Street running a rolling season of Broadway musicals, plays, and youth productions with regular performance runs.

name: Bessie Smith Cultural Center
notes: African American museum and cultural center at 200 E MLK Blvd with recurring lectures, community nights, and annual festivals like the Big 9 Music Fest.

name: Chattanooga Lookouts
notes: Double-A minor league baseball team playing a full home schedule of games with theme nights and promotions at the new Erlanger Park in the South Broad District.

name: TVFCU Riverfront Nights
notes: Free weekly Saturday summer concert series at Ross's Landing with live music, food vendors, and family activities from late May through early September.
